To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the majority of new graduates chose to work at community hospitals; attitudes towards rural work are quite positive; the factors that influenced choice varied between professions; special track recruitment positively influenced rural workplace selection among new doctors attending MOPH annual meetings for workplace selection; and future study of attitudes and retention in rural service of both in-service professionals and new graduates is recommended.
the majority of graduates chose community hospitals, and that attitudes towards rural work are quite positive.
the majority of graduates chose community hospitals, attitudes toward rural work were positive, and factors influencing their choice of rural workplace varied across professions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the attitudes of Thai new graduates towards working in rural communities.
the health workforce in rural areas.
the attitudes and factors influencing the decision to work in remote areas of medical, dental and pharmaceutical graduates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the majority of new medical, dentistry and pharmacy graduates have a positive attitude towards working in rural communities.
a comprehensive and detailed study would be required to provide a more conclusive statement.
the majority of new graduates had positive attitudes towards working in rural service.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the policy of special track recruitment is a promising approach to increasing the distribution of health workers to rural areas, but should be implemented with supporting strategies and should take into consideration the differences between professions.
the Thai government needs a comprehensive and integrated policy for rural workforce distribution.
the Thai government needs to consider different characteristics among professions in the design of policies to increase the rural distribution of health work forces.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need to develop strategies that are specific to each profession and that are tailored to the needs of the graduates.
the Thai government should consider the characteristics and needs of different health professions in the development of health workforce policies and strategies.
there is a need to develop and apply a comprehensive policy that considers different factors influencing each profession.
